title: Captain Milo and the Golden Shell
moral: Staying together and helping each other makes challenges easier.

story: Captain Milo and his crew set out to find the Golden Shell of Calm Seas. The sky turned gray and waves grew big, making the journey difficult. The crew followed dolphins who showed them a safe path through the rough sea. On the island, they discovered the glowing Golden Shell hidden under a rock. The shell made the sea calm, and the crew returned safely, happy and proud.
